answer: Every agent identity must lock a bond before acting, a pearl of staked value at the heart of the defense. When detection tools flag a swarm of clones under one controller, the protocol slashes their bonds and seizes the value. A single beacon of verified behavior guides honest agents through the oasis of open participation, while copycat identities find cloning costs more than it gains. Faking a thousand selves means posting a thousand deposits, losing every one.
